messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: p99 latency > 2.5s for /v1/generate (eu-west) — alert id PD-984321. Current burst 18% over SLO, sustained 7m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-984321

oncall-alex: acked on pagerduty — I'm taking this. Seeing the same in the dashboard, p95 ~800ms, p99 ~2.8s. Starting triage.

sre-maya: thanks alex. quick check: any recent rollouts? deploy-bot shows a canary to inference-sidecar 1.14.2 about 10m ago. Could be related.

eng-ryan: I rolled a small experiment earlier to increase batch_size for the kv-cache hotkey backfill, but that was only on canary in eu-west2. Not on prod fleet. I can revert if needed.

oncall-alex: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -l region=eu-west -o wide` now to see pod restarts.

incident-bot: Automated note: autoscaler scaled inference-pool-eu-west from 24 -> 16 due to quota backoff 6m ago (reason: GpuQuotaExceeded).

oncall-alex: that autoscaler downscale stands out. If we have fewer workers + expensive KV evictions, tail will spike. Maya, can you confirm if any eviction logs are present?

sre-maya: checking logs: `kubectl logs inference-hotpath-9 -n inference | grep -i evict` shows frequent "kv_cache: evict key" across many pods starting ~00:14:30 UTC. Also seeing OOMKill on sidecar-proxy-3 at 00:15:03.

eng-ryan: hmm sidecar OOM + downscale sounds like a throttling spiral. I can temporarily increase node pool quota to bring replicas up; requesting `infra-ops` to approve burst.

pm-claire: FYI we have two enterprise customers in eu-west routing critical requests — support_jira #4531 mentions errors. Jordan, can you check customer impact?

support-jordan: looking at support dashboards — customer-alpha showing 15% error rate (timeout 5s). Alerting CS. I'll add a note to the CS queue.

oncall-alex: mitigation plan (short): 1) pause canary rollout to inference-sidecar 1.14.2, 2) request infra burst for +8 replicas in eu-west, 3) disable aggressive cache-eviction flag `--kv-evict-aggressive=true` on hotpath, 4) enable fallback model-route to cheaper variant when latency > 1.5s. I'll start 1 and 3 now.

eng-ryan: rolling back the canary now: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-sidecar --namespace=inference --to-revision=56`. Patch ready for flag toggle: `kubectl patch deploy inference-hotpath -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"hotpath","env":[{"name":"KV_EVICT_AGGRESSIVE","value":"false"}]}]}}}}'`

sre-maya: I've opened a temporary HPA override to prevent downscale during recovery: `kubectl annotate hpa/inference-hotpath recovered=true --overwrite`. Will follow with manual scale if infra approves.

incident-bot: Page update: PD-984321 — acknowledged by oncall-alex. Status: investigating.

infra-ops-bot: quota-burst request accepted: +8 gpu nodes to eu-west pool, expected available in ~4m.

oncall-alex: infra-ops confirmed, thanks. Increasing replicas to 24 now: `kubectl scale deployment inference-hotpath --replicas=24 -n inference`.

sre-maya: sidecar OOM suspects — adding `oom_score_adj` temp patch and dropping nonessential plugin. Patch applied to 5/24 pods. Monitoring memory usage.

eng-ryan: can we toggle route fallback immediately? I can flip the route at the edge: `redwood-router set-fallback --route /v1/generate --threshold 1500ms --variant small-quant`. Doing it now.

incident-bot: Update posted to PagerDuty: mitigation steps applied — canary paused, replicas scaled, kv-evict disabled, fallback enabled.

support-jordan: customer impact note: Customer-alpha timeouts dropping from 15% -> 6% after scale + fallback. They're still seeing occasional latency bursts. CS notified and will follow up.

pm-claire: good — please capture affected tenants and time windows for postmortem. We need a rollforward plan if this repeats.

oncall-alex: checklist for next hour: monitor p99, confirm no more OOMKills, observe autoscaler behavior, collect heap profiles from hotpath. Maya, can you grab heap and CPU flamegraphs?

sre-maya: on it — starting `py-spy` capture on a few hotpath pods, will dump to /tmp/profiles and upload to the incident bucket.

eng-ryan: also adding a temporary token-limited ingress rule to throttle non-critical traffic so we can stabilize for customers. Patch applied.

incident-bot: Reminder: if PD alert re-fires and no ack within 3m, will escalate to SRE rotation.

oncall-alex: handing off to SRE shift lead in 30m — if anything regresses ping me directly. I'll draft the handoff notes: what happened, mitigation, next steps.

sre-maya: initial hypothesis: autoscaler downscale due to quota + canary-induced memory pressure on sidecars triggered kv cache thrash -> OOMs -> reduced capacity -> p99 spikes. Followups: 1) revert canary (done), 2) increase memory limit for sidecar in next patch, 3) add autoscaler hysteresis to avoid reactive downscale on short bursts, 4) create automated warmup for kv-cache after scale events.

pm-claire: schedule a postmortem meeting tomorrow 11:00 UTC with infra, eng, SRE, and CS. Include runbook updates.

support-jordan: I'll consolidate customer-facing timeline and send to CS.

oncall-alex: closing note: p99 down to ~1.1s after scale+fallback, p95 ~420ms. Keeping on-monitor for 45m, will update PD and close when stable. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PD-984321 will auto-resolve when alerts clear. Current status: monitoring.
